Replace photographic erosion, tiny cracks, dense grain and miniature ornament with broad clean faceted planes, bold chunky silhouette, two or three dominant color blocks, soft painted gradients and a few medium-scale edge accents. Matte materials, clear solid volume, no glossy plastic, no photorealistic surface noise. All views must agree on construction and colors; side views show true depth and back is complete.
